description: This file defines constants, data structures, and function prototypes for managing hardware interrupts on the ESP32 platform within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes interrupt flags, internal interrupt sources, and functions for allocating, freeing, and configuring interrupts.

methods.name: esp_intr_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the interrupt table to its default state.

methods.name: esp_intr_mark_shared
methods.description: Marks a specific interrupt as shared on a given CPU, with optional IRAM residency.

methods.name: esp_intr_reserve
methods.description: Reserves a specific interrupt on a CPU, preventing it from being allocated elsewhere.

methods.name: esp_intr_alloc
methods.description: Allocates an interrupt with specified source, flags, handler, and optional handle.

methods.name: esp_intr_alloc_intrstatus
methods.description: Allocates an interrupt with additional support for interrupt status register and mask.

methods.name: esp_intr_free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated interrupt handle.

methods.name: esp_intr_get_cpu
methods.description: Returns the CPU core number associated with an interrupt handle.

methods.name: esp_intr_get_intno
methods.description: Returns the interrupt number associated with a handle.

methods.name: esp_intr_disable
methods.description: Disables the interrupt associated with a handle.

methods.name: esp_intr_enable
methods.description: Enables the interrupt associated with a handle.

methods.name: esp_intr_set_in_iram
methods.description: Sets whether the handler resides in IRAM, allowing it to run with cache disabled.

methods.name: esp_intr_noniram_disable
methods.description: Disables all interrupts that are not marked as IRAM-resident.
